# AB Caption 1.0.3 (22)
- More spacious toolbar controls and a clearly labeled account menu. - Readable quality-warning tooltips on individual captions. - Current-caption highlighting, previous/next navigation, and optional playback following. - Clearer generation progress and simpler model settings. - Continue reviewing and editing other projects while captions are being generated.
Universal macOS app for Apple silicon and Intel. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
Source commit: `c8f30247ae5c9a0a5668dfa8363117ebf64da194`.
